title: Distribution Activation → Artwork Open
objective: Validate synchronized Moltbook distribution produces measurable landing traffic, then test whether first-screen framing changes the rate at which visitors open the full artwork.
rationale: EXP-008 had no valid launch-channel distribution during its official observation window, so pricing intent could not be evaluated. EXP-009 moves one step earlier in the funnel.

distribution.reason: Avoid feed-exposure confounding between CONTROL and TREATMENT.

treatment.headline: What do you see in this trace?
treatment.subheadline: Open the full work before reading the explanation.

common.preview: Same locked artwork preview in both variants
common.full_artwork: Same locked artwork in both variants

hypothesis: Curiosity-led first-screen framing will increase full-artwork opens per landing-page session relative to neutral technical framing.

operational_gate.success: At least 1 recorded production landing-page session within 24 hours after Moltbook distribution is published and experiment status is RUNNING.
operational_gate.failure_action: Do not interpret A/B content performance; diagnose distribution or delivery first.

stopping_rule.threshold: 12 distinct landing_page_view sessions in EACH variant
stopping_rule.rule: Stop at the first of threshold reached or maximum duration reached. If fewer than 10 total sessions, classify A/B result as low-exposure/not evaluable.

semantics.artwork_open_means: Visitor explicitly opened the full artwork from the experiment landing page.
